The two plots share the same x-axis, which is labeled "Години" (Years) and has a discrete scale with values ranging from 2008 to 2021, with tick labels at 2008, 2012, 2013, 2017, and 2021. 

The first plot, labeled "A", has a y-axis labeled "Средни леподии (дни)" (Mean Lepodii (days)) with a linear scale, ranging from 200 to 280, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot displays a single red line with circular markers and a solid line style, which decreases from approximately 275 days in 2008 to around 202 days in 2021, with a slight increase between 2012 and 2013, from about 265 to 267 days, before continuing its decline to 240 days in 2017.

The second plot, labeled "Б", has a y-axis labeled "Структурен ефект върху средни леподии (%)" (Structural effect on mean lepodii (%)) with a linear scale, ranging from 1.0 to 2.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays a single red line with circular markers and a solid line style, which decreases from approximately 1.5% in 2008 to around 0.8% in 2013, then increases to about 1.2% in 2017, and further rises to approximately 2.1% in 2021.
